title: Patient Services Representative
description:
Description
Do you enjoy helping people, solving problems, and making a positive difference through exceptional customer service?
We are seeking compassionate, detail-oriented Patient Services Representatives to support a US-based healthcare organization. In this remote role, you will serve as an important first point of contact for patients, helping them schedule appointments, obtain general administrative information, and navigate routine inquiries with professionalism and care.
Every interaction matters. The ideal candidate understands the importance of listening carefully, communicating clearly, protecting confidential information, and ensuring that patients feel heard and supported.
This opportunity is well suited to candidates with customer service or call center experience who want to apply their communication and organizational skills in a healthcare environment.
Previous healthcare experience is an advantage, but it is not required. Paid training will help you learn the relevant systems, procedures, and expectations for the role.
Key Responsibilities

• Answer incoming patient calls promptly and professionally, providing courteous and helpful assistance.

• Schedule, reschedule, confirm, and cancel medical appointments accurately.

• Assist patients with general appointment-related questions and administrative inquiries.

• Verify and record patient information according to established procedures.

• Document calls, patient requests, messages, and follow-up actions accurately in the appropriate systems.

• Route messages and inquiries to the appropriate healthcare providers or administrative teams.

• Follow scheduling protocols and coordinate appointments according to availability and service requirements.

• Navigate scheduling software, patient management systems, and other computer applications while assisting patients.

• Maintain a calm, empathetic, and professional approach when assisting frustrated, concerned, or anxious callers.

• Protect confidential patient information and follow applicable privacy, security, and HIPAA-related procedures.

• Follow established workflows, quality standards, and documentation requirements.

• Escalate clinical questions or sensitive issues to the appropriate personnel rather than providing information outside your responsibilities.

Technical Requirements (Non-Negotiable)
Applicants must have their own equipment and a suitable home workspace that meets all of the following requirements:

• Windows 11 PC (Mac not supported)

• Minimum 16 GB RAM

• Intel i5 processor or higher

• Dual monitors

• Webcam and wired USB headset

• Fiber internet with a wired Ethernet connection

• Backup power solution

• Microsoft Teams and Office 365

Applications that do not meet the minimum technical requirements may not move forward in the hiring process.

• Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

• Applicants must be able to work the full schedule consistently.

Rate: $5.50 USD per hour

•

•

title: Senior Cost Manager / Quantity Surveyor - Real Estate
description:

To be successful in this role, you will possess exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills and be comfortable operating in a client-facing environment. The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, results-driven, and capable of working independently in a remote setting while collaborating effectively with project teams, clients, consultants, and contractors. This leadership position requires a strong understanding of the full cost management lifecycle, from planning and design through construction and closeout, as well as the ability to drive commercial outcomes across multiple real estate projects.
You will be responsible for providing leadership and direction while embedding and promoting the purpose, values, and vision of Turner & Townsend.

Responsibilities:

• Estimating and negotiating change orders throughout the construction lifecycle. 

• Provide estimate and cost planning to include producing and presenting the final cost plan. 

• Review and participate with the design services team and general contractor in the development of cost estimates. 

• Reconcile changes and assist the general contractor to ensure that their data is accurate. 

• Communicate or meet with the general contractor and owner of project manager to gather status information to prepare a cost estimate update. 

• Prepare written comments to the general contractor’s submissions, including the executive summary. 

• Coordinate all sources of cost information for cost discussions and suppliers direct from NPA, subs, quantities from A/Es. 

• Inform and drive engineering priorities based on cost impact. 

• Work proactively with minimal supervision to resolve scheduling issues. 

• Manage cost checks and carry out valuations on larger projects. Complete timely, accurate cost checking and valuation processes.

• Manage Cost impact / contingency management and commitment tracking logs. 

• Prepare funding data presentations and coordinate VE sessions with stakeholders.

• Providing commercial input to design optioneering and input into value engineering exercises. 

• Reviewing contractor and subcontractor pricing and leading negotiations on behalf of the client to drive fair contract prices. 

• Performing quantity surveying, cost controls, and change management activities throughout the project lifecycle. 

• Ensuring that post-contract cost variances and change control processes are managed effectively. 

• Ensuring that cost auditing and valuation work is managed effectively and that a robust process for cost validation is in place. 

• Carrying out the production of monthly cost reports for presentation to the client. 

• Ensuring that final accounts are negotiated and agreed upon in a timely manner.

• Identify, coach and mentor talent to realize their potential and celebrate the success of others.

• Display excellence in leadership and service delivery on commissions is in line with the conditions of appointment

• Implement and maintain the use of internal Business Management Systems and company delivery methodologies and tools in the office to ensure consistent delivery of best practice for Clients and the company

• Be a role model that drives a one business culture

- Can take an ambiguous brief, ask the right questions, and make smart calls without constant direction

- Are excited to work in-person from our Paddington, London HQ (Hybrid)

- You are shipping independently, scoping and building features that users love without needing to be unblocked at every step.

- People come to you not just to get things done but because they want your input on problems that are still half-formed.

title: Systems Engineering/DevSecOps Lead
description:
Overview
DecisionPoint seeks a Systems Engineering/ DevSecOps Lead to maintain secure, reliable, and repeatable software delivery processes supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
This position will maintain continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, automated checks, application environment configurations, artifact promotion, and deployment and rollback automation. The lead will apply infrastructure as code and automated testing to improve consistency across development, testing, and production environments.
The Systems Engineering/DevSecOps Lead will collaborate with software developers, architects, testers, cybersecurity personnel, release management staff, and operations teams to resolve delivery issues and support controlled releases. This is a hands-on technical lead role aligned with the Journeyman labor category.
This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.
Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.
Duties & Responsibilities
The Systems Engineering/DevSecOps Lead will:

• Maintain CI/CD pipelines supporting application builds, automated checks, testing, packaging, and deployment.

• Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code definitions and application environment configurations.

• Promote consistent, reproducible configurations across development, testing, staging, and production environments.

• Integrate automated functional, integration, regression, and approved security checks into delivery pipelines.

• Configure pipeline quality gates and retain execution results supporting release decisions.

• Maintain artifact repositories, versioning, dependencies, and promotion controls.

• Own cluster lifecycle at scale: upgrades, capacity expansion, node health checks, automated remediation and decommissioning.

• Define and meet SLOs for cluster availability, node bring-up time and GPU utilization.

• Invest in observability across hardware, networking, Kubernetes and workloads so failures are found before customers see them.

• Cut the time from racked hardware to customer-ready capacity.

• 8+ years in infrastructure, SRE or platform engineering, including 2+ years managing engineers.

• Experience building automation for fleet provisioning and lifecycle with tools such as Cluster API, Metal3, Ironic, MAAS, Ansible or Terraform.

• A track record of owning production systems with on-call, SLOs and incident response.

• Strong technical judgment: you can review designs, debug alongside the team and make clear trade-offs.

• Clear communication with engineers, leadership and external partners.

• Experience operating large NVIDIA GPU clusters (H100, H200, B200, GB200) and the NVIDIA GPU and Network Operators, DCGM and NCCL.

• Familiarity with InfiniBand, RoCE, SR-IOV and high-performance storage for AI workloads.

• Experience with Slurm, Kueue, Volcano or other batch schedulers for training workloads.

• Contributions to Kubernetes or related CNCF projects.

• Experience at an AI lab, GPU cloud or hyperscaler.
